title: Nocturne in Slow Steps
description: A sparse, melody-led future-garage cut at 130 BPM built on a swung half-time 2-step skeleton with lots of space. A chopped, pitch-shifted vocal hook drifts over sidechained lush pads, deep sine sub and an organ-stab progression, while euclid hats and a perlin-driven filter keep it slowly evolving from a dreamy, nocturnal intro to a romantic peak and back.
